coreConcepts.definition: A power gap means one side is much stronger than the other side.
coreConcepts.whyItMatters: It changes the action question. We do not only ask if the hero can win.

coreConcepts.definition: Anticlimax means a big setup ends in a small or sudden way.
coreConcepts.whyItMatters: It makes the one-punch ending feel surprising and funny.

coreConcepts.definition: Contrast means two very different things are next to each other.
coreConcepts.whyItMatters: A serious world and a calm hero make the comedy clearer.

coreConcepts.definition: Stakes are the things that can be lost or saved in a story.
coreConcepts.whyItMatters: Other heroes and citizens keep the world important.

coreConcepts.definition: Timing means when something happens and how fast it happens.
coreConcepts.whyItMatters: A pause, a reaction, and a fast result can make a joke stronger.

connectionMap.label: Comedy timing chain
connectionMap.explanation: The story builds a big moment, waits for a second, then ends it fast. That rhythm creates surprise.

connectionMap.label: Story stakes chain
connectionMap.explanation: The hero is too strong, so the wider world must carry danger, emotion, and questions.

miniCaseStudy.scenario: A learner explains why a short fight in One-Punch Man can still be funny.
miniCaseStudy.analysis: The learner connects power gap, serious setup, anticlimax, and timing instead of only saying the hero is strong.
miniCaseStudy.takeaway: A good anime explanation shows how the story parts work together.

trackingChecklist.note: Say why a very strong hero changes the story question.
Find one serious thing and one funny thing in a scene.
Notice how the story prepares you for a big moment.
Explain why a sudden ending can be funny.
Say what can be lost or saved besides the main fight.
Notice a pause, reaction, or fast movement.
Compare this idea with another anime you know.

comprehension: Why do other heroes and citizens keep the story important?
discussion: Do you like heroes who are too strong? Why or why not?
Can a very short fight still be exciting? Why?
speaking: Explain the comedy timing chain in your own words.
Explain why One-Punch Man can be funny and exciting at the same time.
